name: am-qa-agents
description: Monorepo wrappers — backend API + Flutter portal + smoke/tests + release report

scripts.backend:import: python scripts/with_pythonpath.py python -c "from composition.app import app; print(getattr(app,'title','ok'), len(app.routes))"
scripts.ui: python scripts/npm_run_log.py ui -- python scripts/with_pythonpath.py python scripts/ui_flow_cli.py
scripts.release:report: python scripts/npm_run_log.py release-report -- python scripts/with_pythonpath.py python qa-agent/scripts/release_report.py
scripts.release:report:prod: npm run release:report -- --env prod --suite prod_ui_full --url https://am.asrax.in --login-mode credentials
scripts.release:final: python scripts/npm_run_log.py release-final -- python scripts/with_pythonpath.py python qa-agent/scripts/release_final_run.py
scripts.release:all:prod: npm run release:report:prod && npm run release:final:prod
scripts.release:ops: python scripts/npm_run_log.py release-ops -- python scripts/with_pythonpath.py python qa-agent/scripts/start_release_ops_workflow.py
scripts.release:ops:prod: npm run release:ops -- --env prod --suite prod_ui_full --url https://am.asrax.in --login-mode credentials --soak-min 30
scripts.release:request: python scripts/npm_run_log.py release-request -- python scripts/with_pythonpath.py python qa-agent/scripts/request_release_ops.py
scripts.release:request:prod: npm run release:request -- --env prod --suite prod_ui_full --url https://am.asrax.in --soak-min 30
scripts.test:flow: npm run api:smoke && npm run agent:test
